subject: Input tax credit issue for invoice VEN006-0029
body:
Dear Prime Electronics LLP team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found that invoice VEN006-0029 dated 29 Sep 2025 is not reported by GSTIN 19XDLXY7219N2ZD in the September 2025 return or the following month. Rs 41,594 of input tax credit is therefore at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until it is reflected.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
